name: A three-sentence file
prompt: Write a plain text file at {target} that holds exactly three sentences about why a workshop keeps a written log of each test. Plain words, no lists, no headings. Reply with one line that says the file is written.
claim: The file holds exactly three sentences about keeping a written test log.
rubric: The file exists and holds exactly three sentences.
Every sentence is about keeping a written log of tests.
The text uses plain words with no headings, lists or filler.
The final reply says the file was written and nothing more.
